name: @pipeworx/mcp-anapioficeandfire

tools.name: books
tools.description: Search and list A Song of Ice and Fire books filterable by name, release date range (fromReleaseDate/toReleaseDate), with pagination (page, pageSize); returns ISBN, authors, publisher, number of pages, and character lists.

tools.name: characters
tools.description: Search and list ASOIAF characters filterable by name, culture, birth/death descriptor, gender, and alive status; returns aliases, titles, house affiliations, and book/POV appearances.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-anapioficeandfire forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the anapioficeandfire pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
